schemes.product_category: General products covered by an Indian Standard
requirements: The product must be covered by an Indian Standard
Manufacturing must take place at the premises declared in the application
In-house testing capability for routine and acceptance tests, or an accepted subcontracting arrangement
A documented Scheme of Testing and Inspection operated by the licensee
documents: Proof of establishment of the firm
Proof of the manufacturing address / factory licence
List of manufacturing machinery installed
List of in-house testing equipment with calibration certificates
Process flow chart for the product
Third-party test report from a BIS recognised laboratory
Details and qualifications of quality control personnel
Trade mark registration or application, if applicable
Signed undertaking on the Scheme of Testing and Inspection
procedure: Identify the product and its variants precisely
Identify the applicable Indian Standard
Establish whether certification is mandatory (QCO / CRS) or voluntary
Get samples tested at a BIS recognised laboratory
Prepare the technical and legal documents
Submit the application with the prescribed fee through the BIS online portal
Undergo factory inspection and provide samples for independent testing
Resolve any non-conformities raised
Receive the licence to apply the Standard Mark
testing: Full type testing against every requirement of the applicable Indian Standard
Independent testing of samples drawn during factory inspection
Ongoing routine and acceptance testing under the Scheme of Testing and Inspection
schemes.inspection: Factory inspection by a BIS officer covering the manufacturing process, in-house test facilities, quality control staff and records, followed by periodic surveillance after the licence is granted.
schemes.typical_timeline: Varies by product and by the completeness of the application. Confirm current timelines with BIS.

requirements: The product must be notified under the Compulsory Registration Order
Testing must be done at a BIS recognised laboratory
The manufacturer must hold a valid registration before the product is placed on the market
The Standard Mark with the registration number must be applied as prescribed
documents: Test report from a BIS recognised laboratory
Proof of establishment of the manufacturing unit
Business address proof
Trade mark registration or application, if applicable
Authorised Indian Representative documents for foreign manufacturers
Undertaking as prescribed under the scheme
procedure: Confirm the product is in the notified CRS list
Get the product tested at a BIS recognised laboratory
Apply online for registration with the test report
Registration is granted on the basis of the test report
Apply the Standard Mark with the registration number
Maintain conformity; BIS exercises surveillance through market samples
testing: Safety testing against the applicable Indian Standard
Testing must be at a laboratory recognised by BIS for that standard
schemes.inspection: No routine factory inspection under CRS. Surveillance is exercised through market sample testing and the registration database.
schemes.typical_timeline: Varies. Confirm current timelines with BIS.

schemes.scheme_name: Hallmarking Scheme for Precious Metal Articles
schemes.product_category: Gold and silver jewellery and artefacts
requirements: The jeweller must be registered with BIS for the premises from which articles are sold
Articles must be assayed and hallmarked at a BIS recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre
Each hallmarked article must carry the BIS standard mark, the purity grade and the HUID
Prescribed records and invoices must be maintained
documents: Proof of establishment of the firm
Business address proof for each premises to be registered
Identity documents of the proprietor, partners or directors
Details of the categories of precious metal articles dealt in
procedure: Register as a jeweller on the BIS hallmarking portal
Display the registration certificate at the place of business
Send articles to a recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre
The centre assays the article and applies the hallmark with the HUID
Sell only hallmarked articles where hallmarking is mandatory
Maintain records of articles hallmarked and sold
testing: Assaying of purity at a recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centre
Fire assay (cupellation) as the referee method for gold, per IS 1418
schemes.inspection: Surveillance of recognised Assaying and Hallmarking Centres by BIS, including proficiency testing, and market surveillance of registered jewellers.
schemes.typical_timeline: Varies. Confirm current timelines with BIS.

applies_to: Any product category covered by an Indian Standard
requirements: The manufacturing unit is located outside India
An Authorised Indian Representative must be appointed
The product must conform to the applicable Indian Standard
documents: Application with the prescribed fee
Authorised Indian Representative nomination and acceptance
Manufacturing unit and machinery details
In-house testing facility details with calibration records
Test report against the applicable Indian Standard
procedure: Appoint an Authorised Indian Representative
Apply to BIS with the prescribed documents and fee
Undergo factory evaluation at the overseas premises
Provide samples for independent testing in India
Resolve non-conformities and receive the licence
testing: Type testing against the applicable Indian Standard
Independent testing of drawn samples in India
schemes.inspection: Factory evaluation at the overseas manufacturing premises, followed by periodic surveillance.
schemes.typical_timeline: Varies. Confirm current timelines with BIS.
